# idcloudhost-js-client

> TypeScript SDK for the IDCloudHost API (https://api.idcloudhost.com). Zero runtime dependencies — uses the platform's native `fetch`. Unofficial, AI-generated client; not affiliated with IDCloudHost.

Key links:

- [GitHub repository](https://github.com/RayhanHamada/idcloudhost-js-client)
- [Official IDCloudHost API docs](https://api.idcloudhost.com/)
- [Package on npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/idcloudhost-js-client)

## Installation

```sh
# bun
bun add idcloudhost-js-client

# npm
npm install idcloudhost-js-client

# pnpm
pnpm add idcloudhost-js-client

# yarn
yarn add idcloudhost-js-client
```

## Quickstart

```ts
import { IdCloudHostClient, waitForVmStatus } from "idcloudhost-js-client";

const client = new IdCloudHostClient({ apiKey: process.env.IDCLOUDHOST_API_KEY });

// Locations
const locations = await client.config.listLocations();

// List VMs in the default location
const vms = await client.vm.list();

// Create a VM
const vm = await client.vm.create({
    name: "web-server",
    osName: "ubuntu",
    osVersion: "24.04",
    vcpu: 2,
    ram: 2048,
    disks: 40,
    username: "root",
    password: "Secret1234",
});

// Stop the VM and wait for the operation to finish
await client.vm.stop(vm.uuid, { force: true });
await waitForVmStatus(client.vm, vm.uuid, "stopped");

// Location-scoped operations
const jkt = client.withLocation("jkt01");
const jktVms = await jkt.vm.list();
```

## Authentication

The API key is sent in the `apikey` header of every request:

```ts
const client = new IdCloudHostClient({ apiKey: "meowmeowmeow" });
```

## Client options

```ts
interface IdCloudHostClientOptions {
    apiKey: string;                    // IDCloudHost API token (required)
    baseUrl?: string;                  // Defaults to "https://api.idcloudhost.com"
    location?: string;                 // Location slug, e.g. "jkt01"
    headers?: Record<string, string>;  // Merged into every request; apikey wins
}
```

## Locations

Location-specific resources (VMs, block storage, networks, floating IPs, firewalls, load balancers, billing resources) are addressed through a location slug. By default the API's default location is used. Target a specific location with `withLocation`:

```ts
const client = new IdCloudHostClient({ apiKey: "..." });
const bus02 = client.withLocation("bus02");

await bus02.vm.list();  // GET /v1/bus02/user-resource/vm/list
await client.vm.list(); // GET /v1/user-resource/vm/list
```

## API coverage

| Namespace | Resources |
| --- | --- |
| `client.config` | locations, VM parameters, VM images (plain OS / app catalog), boot images, pricing policy |
| `client.user` | user info, profile, SSH keys |
| `client.token` | API token CRUD |
| `client.vm` | list/get/create/modify/delete, start/stop, change password, reinstall, rebuild, clone, auto backup, host pools, replicas, boot ISO media, attached disks |
| `client.storage.disks` | block storage disks CRUD, attach/detach |
| `client.storage.buckets` | S3 buckets CRUD, S3 API info, S3 keys |
| `client.network.privateNetworks` | private network CRUD, default, rename |
| `client.network.floatingIps` | floating IP CRUD, assign/unassign |
| `client.network.firewalls` | firewall CRUD, assign/unassign to VMs |
| `client.network.loadBalancers` | load balancer CRUD, targets, forwarding rules, billing account |
| `client.billing` | billing account resources, resource billing configuration |
| `client.payment` | billing accounts, credit cards, credit, invoices, payments, campaigns |
| `client.charging` | resource usage |
| `client.services` | managed service packages, secrets, whitelists |

## VM operations

```ts
// Create with all options
const vm = await client.vm.create({
    name: "db-server",
    osName: "ubuntu",
    osVersion: "24.04",
    disks: 40,             // size of main storage in GB
    vcpu: 2,
    ram: 4096,             // RAM in MB
    username: "root",
    password: "Secret1234",
    billingAccountId: 123,
    designatedPoolUuid: "pool-uuid",
    networkUuid: "network-uuid",
    backup: true,          // enable automatic backups
    publicKeys: ["ssh-ed25519 AAAA..."], // OpenSSH public key lines
    reservePublicIp: true,
    sourceUuid: "vm-uuid", // clone source
    cloudInit: "#cloud-config\n...",
});

// Get, modify, delete
const one = await client.vm.get(vm.uuid);
await client.vm.modify({ uuid: vm.uuid, name: "renamed", vcpu: 4, ram: 8192 });
await client.vm.delete(vm.uuid);

// Lifecycle
await client.vm.start(vm.uuid);
await client.vm.stop(vm.uuid, { force: true }); // graceful ACPI first unless force
await client.vm.changePassword({ uuid: vm.uuid, username: "root", password: "NewSecret1" });
await client.vm.reinstall({ uuid: vm.uuid, osName: "ubuntu", osVersion: "22.04" });

// Replicas (snapshots/backups)
await client.vm.createReplica(vm.uuid);
const replicas = await client.vm.listReplicas({ uuid: vm.uuid, type: "snapshot" });
await client.vm.rebuild({ uuid: vm.uuid, replicaUuid: replicas[0].uuid });
await client.vm.deleteReplica({ replicaUuid: replicas[0].uuid });

// Clone
await client.vm.clone({ uuid: vm.uuid, name: "db-server-clone" });

// Auto backup toggle and host pools
await client.vm.toggleAutoBackup(vm.uuid);
const pools = await client.vm.listHostPools();

// Boot ISO media (one-shot live boot)
await client.vm.bootIsoMedia({ uuid: vm.uuid, bootImageUuid: "iso-uuid", bootImageRepository: "private" });

// Disks attached to a VM
const disk = await client.vm.addDisk({ uuid: vm.uuid, sizeGb: 20 });
await client.vm.modifyDisk({ uuid: vm.uuid, diskUuid: disk.uuid, sizeGb: 40 });
await client.vm.deleteDisk({ uuid: vm.uuid, storageUuid: disk.uuid });
```

Deprecated: `vm.releasePublicIp(uuid)` and `vm.reservePublicIp(uuid)` — use `client.network.floatingIps` instead.

## Block storage (location-specific)

```ts
// Create a disk from an OS base image
const disk = await client.storage.disks.create({
    sizeGb: 20,
    sourceImageType: "OS_BASE",
    sourceImage: "ubuntu_20.04",
    displayName: "data-disk",
    billingAccountId: 123, // required with a global API token
});

const disks = await client.storage.disks.list({ readOnlyBootable: false });
const one = await client.storage.disks.get(disk.uuid);
await client.storage.disks.modify(disk.uuid, { displayName: "renamed" });

// Attach/detach to a VM
await client.storage.disks.attach({ uuid: vm.uuid, storageUuid: disk.uuid });
await client.storage.disks.detach({ uuid: vm.uuid, storageUuid: disk.uuid });

await client.storage.disks.delete(disk.uuid); // deletes snapshots too
```

`DiskSourceImageType` is `"OS_BASE" | "DISK" | "SNAPSHOT" | "EMPTY"`.

## Object storage / S3 (global)

```ts
const { url } = await client.storage.buckets.getS3Info();

const bucket = await client.storage.buckets.create({ name: "my-bucket" });
await client.storage.buckets.list({ billingAccountId: 123 });
await client.storage.buckets.get("my-bucket");
await client.storage.buckets.modify({ name: "my-bucket", billingAccountId: 456 });
await client.storage.buckets.delete("my-bucket"); // only empty buckets

// S3 keys
const keys = await client.storage.buckets.listKeys();
const all = await client.storage.buckets.generateKey(); // returns all keys
await client.storage.buckets.deleteKey(keys[0].accessKey);
```

## Networking (location-specific)

### Private networks

```ts
const networks = await client.network.privateNetworks.list();
const net = await client.network.privateNetworks.create({ name: "lan" });
await client.network.privateNetworks.get(net.uuid);
await client.network.privateNetworks.rename(net.uuid, { name: "new-lan" });
await client.network.privateNetworks.setDefault(net.uuid);
await client.network.privateNetworks.delete(net.uuid); // must be empty and not default
```

### Floating IPs

```ts
const ips = await client.network.floatingIps.list({ billingAccountId: 123, vmUuid: vm.uuid });
const ip = await client.network.floatingIps.create({ billingAccountId: 123, name: "web-ip" });
await client.network.floatingIps.get(ip.address);
await client.network.floatingIps.assign(ip.address, {
    assignedTo: vm.uuid,
    assignedToResourceType: "virtual_machine", // or "service" | "load_balancer"
});
await client.network.floatingIps.unassign(ip.address);
await client.network.floatingIps.modify(ip.address, { name: "renamed-ip" });
await client.network.floatingIps.delete(ip.address);
```

### Firewalls

```ts
const fw = await client.network.firewalls.create({
    displayName: "web-firewall",
    rules: [
        {
            protocol: "tcp",
            direction: "inbound",
            port_start: 443,
            port_end: 443,
            endpoint_spec_type: "ip_prefixes",
            endpoint_spec: ["0.0.0.0/0"],
        },
        {
            protocol: "tcp",
            direction: "inbound",
            port_start: 22,
            port_end: null, // equal to port_start
            endpoint_spec_type: "any",
        },
    ],
});

await client.network.firewalls.assignVm(fw.uuid, { vmUuid: vm.uuid });
await client.network.firewalls.unassignVm(fw.uuid, { vmUuid: vm.uuid });
await client.network.firewalls.update(fw.uuid, { description: "updated" });
await client.network.firewalls.delete(fw.uuid);
```

### Load balancers

```ts
const lb = await client.network.loadBalancers.create({
    displayName: "web-lb",
    networkUuid: net.uuid,
    reservePublicIp: true,
    rules: [{ sourcePort: 443, targetPort: 8443 }],
    targets: [{ targetUuid: vm.uuid, targetType: "vm" }],
});

await client.network.loadBalancers.addTarget(lb.uuid, { targetUuid: vm2.uuid, targetType: "vm" });
await client.network.loadBalancers.removeTarget(lb.uuid, vm2.uuid);
const rule = await client.network.loadBalancers.addForwardingRule(lb.uuid, { sourcePort: 80, targetPort: 8080 });
await client.network.loadBalancers.removeForwardingRule(lb.uuid, rule.uuid);
await client.network.loadBalancers.setBillingAccount(lb.uuid, { billingAccountId: 456 });
await client.network.loadBalancers.rename(lb.uuid, { displayName: "renamed-lb" });
await client.network.loadBalancers.delete(lb.uuid);
```

## Config (global)

```ts
const locations = await client.config.listLocations();   // GET /v1/config/locations
const params = await client.config.getVmParameters();    // GET /v1/api/parameters/vm
const images = await client.config.listVmImages();       // GET /v1/config/vm_images
const osImages = await client.config.listPlainOsImages();
const appImages = await client.config.listAppCatalogImages();
const bootIsos = await client.config.listBootImages();
const pricing = await client.config.getPricingPolicy();
```

## User and tokens (global)

```ts
const me = await client.user.get();
await client.user.updateProfile({ firstName: "Ada", lastName: "Lovelace" });

const key = await client.user.createSshKey({ name: "laptop", publicKey: "ssh-ed25519 AAAA..." });
await client.user.renameSshKey(key.uuid, { name: "work-laptop" });
await client.user.deleteSshKey(key.uuid);

const tokens = await client.token.list();
await client.token.create({ description: "ci-token", restricted: true, billingAccountId: 123 });
await client.token.update({ tokenId: 1, description: "updated" });
await client.token.delete({ tokenId: 1 });
```

## Billing, payment, charging

```ts
// Billing (location-specific)
const resources = await client.billing.listResources({ id: 123, resourceType: "vm" });
await client.billing.setResourceBilling({ billingAccountId: 123, uuid: vm.uuid });

// Payment (global)
const accounts = await client.payment.listBillingAccounts({ showShadow: false });
const account = await client.payment.getBillingAccount({ billingAccountId: 123 });
await client.payment.getUnpaidAmount({ billingAccountId: 123 });
await client.payment.setDefaultBillingAccount({ billingAccountId: 123 });
await client.payment.updateBillingAccount({
    billingAccountId: 123,
    account: { city: "Jakarta", ... }, // all fields must be re-passed
});
await client.payment.configureRecurringPayment(123, {
    isRecurringPaymentEnabled: true,
    recurringPaymentAmount: 100,
    recurringPaymentThreshold: 50,
});

// Cards
const cards = await client.payment.listCards({ billingAccountId: 123 });
await client.payment.addCard({ billingAccountId: 123, token: "processor-token" });
await client.payment.setCardPrimary({ paymentObjectId: 1 });
await client.payment.removeCard({ paymentObjectId: 1 });

// Credit and invoices
await client.payment.buyCredit({ billingAccountId: 123, paymentObjectId: 1, amount: 500 });
const invoices = await client.payment.listInvoices({ billingAccountId: 123 }); // status: 5=unpaid, 10=paid
await client.payment.payInvoice({ invoiceId: invoices[0].id });
await client.payment.payAll({ billingAccountId: 123 });
await client.payment.payAmount({ billingAccountId: 123, amount: 250 });
await client.payment.hasActiveCampaigns();

// Charging (global)
const usage = await client.charging.getUsage({ billingAccountId: 123 });
```

## Managed services (global CRUD, location-specific whitelists)

```ts
const svc = await client.services.create({
    billingAccountId: 123,
    service: "postgresql", // e.g. postgresql, mariadb
    version: "14",
    displayName: "my-db",
    vmCpu: 1,
    vmRam: 1024,
    vmDiskGb: 20,
    packageParameters: JSON.stringify({ location: "jkt01" }),
    isMultiNode: false,
});

const secrets = await client.services.getSecrets(svc.uuid); // e.g. DB passwords
await client.services.addWhitelistEntry(svc.uuid, { ipAddress: "203.0.113.10" });
const whitelist = await client.services.listWhitelist(svc.uuid);
await client.services.removeWhitelistEntry(svc.uuid, { ipAddress: "203.0.113.10" });
await client.services.update(svc.uuid, { displayName: "renamed-db" });
await client.services.delete(svc.uuid);
```

## Errors

Failed requests throw an `IdCloudHostError` with the HTTP status, the parsed body and the API's `errors` object:

```ts
import { IdCloudHostError } from "idcloudhost-js-client";

try {
    await client.vm.get("nope");
} catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof IdCloudHostError) {
        console.error(error.status, error.errors); // e.g. 404, { uuid: "VM not found" }
    }
}
```

The API reports failures in the body as `{"errors": {...}}`; the SDK extracts that object and uses the first message as the `Error` message.

## Waiting for async operations

VM operations like start, stop and reinstall are asynchronous. Poll with `waitFor` / `waitForVmStatus`:

```ts
import { waitFor, waitForVmStatus, WaitTimeoutError } from "idcloudhost-js-client";

await client.vm.start(vm.uuid);
const running = await waitForVmStatus(client.vm, vm.uuid, "running", {
    timeoutMs: 300_000, // default 5 minutes
    intervalMs: 5_000,  // default 5 seconds
});

// Generic polling
const disk = await waitFor(
    () => client.storage.disks.get(diskUuid),
    (result) => result.status === "Active"
);

// Throws WaitTimeoutError if the condition is not met in time
try {
    await waitForVmStatus(client.vm, vm.uuid, "stopped", { timeoutMs: 10_000 });
} catch (error) {
    if (error instanceof WaitTimeoutError) {
        console.error("VM did not stop in time");
    }
}
```

## Raw requests

Resource methods are thin wrappers around the client's `request` method. Use it for endpoints the SDK does not cover yet:

```ts
// client.request<T>(method, path, options)
// path is relative to /v1[/{location}], without a leading slash

const result = await client.request<{ uuid: string }>("POST", "user-resource/vm", {
    form: { name: "x", vcpu: 1, ram: 1024 },  // application/x-www-form-urlencoded
});

const data = await client.request("PATCH", "network/network/uuid", {
    json: { name: "new-name" },               // application/json
});

const list = await client.request("GET", "user-resource/vm/list", {
    query: { page: 2 },
});
```

`FormValue[]` arrays are repeated as multiple form fields.

## Development

```sh
bun install
bun test          # vitest
bun run typecheck # tsc --noEmit
bun run check     # ultracite (oxlint + oxfmt check)
bun run build     # tsdown
```

The package ships ESM only (`"type": "module"`, `dist/index.mjs`), TypeScript 6, no runtime dependencies. Releases are tagged via bumpp (`bun run release`) and published through the GitHub release workflow.

## Contributing

Contributions are welcome. This client is AI-generated and not all operations have been verified against a production account, so reports from real-world usage are especially valuable. Open an issue or PR on [GitHub](https://github.com/RayhanHamada/idcloudhost-js-client), and include the relevant endpoint docs or a sample request/response when reporting API mismatches.
